name: Demo deployment: single-container tier + zero-touch AI setup
description:
Implement the fast/demo deployment of codx-junior (tier 1).

Delivered:
- codx-junior-installer/demo/: docker-compose.yaml (1 container, port 19981, optional --profile knowledge), Dockerfile (node builder + python:3.11-slim + nginx, no torch/vLLM/Playwright/TeX/Node at runtime), nginx.conf (SPA + /api proxy, removes Traefik and the client container), supervisord.conf (api + api-background + web in one container), entrypoint.sh (no installs at boot), .env.example (full settings surface), up.sh (one command: validate settings, .env bootstrap, pull/build, start, health wait, apply AI provider), README.md (settings documentation: required vs optional, provider presets, auto-configuration, what is left out, operations, troubleshooting).
- api/codx/junior/bootstrap.py + api/codx/junior/api/bootstrap.py (GET /api/bootstrap, POST /api/bootstrap/apply) + startup hook in app.py: creates the AIProvider and its models and fills the five global model slots from CODX_JUNIOR_AI_* env vars, idempotent.
- Root .dockerignore (the build context is the repo root and had no ignore file).
- api/pyproject.toml: torch, sentence-transformers, playwright, vllm moved to extras (local-models, browser, vllm, full) + tool.uv default-extras; scripts/install_api.sh installs .[local-models,browser] so full deployments are unchanged; scripts/run_api.sh skips chown -R + uv sync when CODX_JUNIOR_SKIP_INSTALL=1.
- docs/getting-started.md: demo is the first path. FAST-DEPLOYMENT.md: section 7 with what is implemented and what is still open.

Pending: publish codxjunior/codx-junior:demo from CI (up.sh --build is the fallback), LanceDB knowledge backend, embedding-dim metadata, image models in the presets, profile split for the server tier.
